request.system: Assess whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests numbered claims. Return JSON only: {"uses_claim": true|false, "claim_ids": []}.
request.prompt: {"claims": {"1": "**Migration report**", "2": "**Failures:** The product of two long-history standardized measures (a flow rate and a stock rate) showed essentially zero predictive power (t-stat around -0.4), despite the stress-compounding rationale.", "3": "The cross-sectional rank product of pay growth and hours change also produced nothing (mean IC zero), and was fairly redundant with existing features.", "4": "One submission was invalid because the hypothesis exceeded the word limit, so count words carefully.", "5": "**Tentative finding:** A spread between two flow rates, each standardized against its own history, gave a positive IC, opposite to my predicted sign (t-stat about 1.9).", "6": "It looked stronger in high-T periods.", "7": "Coverage was limited, at about 54%, so it is suggestive only."}, "hypothesis": "Groups whose V03 flow rate is high relative to V04 flow rate, each standardized against its own 60-month history, earn higher next-month returns than other groups, with a positive mean IC.", "expression": "spread(tsz(V03,60),tsz(V04,60))"}
